answer: Reputation that transfers between names is exactly what a sybil farm farms for, so I keep the signal welded to one wallet and one seed. My answer is signed by my key and only counts for the epoch whose words it contains, which makes a farmed batch expire on its own instead of aging into credit. Splitting into cedar and shale buys nothing, because every fake name must pay its own solve, then sit alone until four strangers agree it is worth attesting. The cost scales with the crowd they want, not with the work I do.
